name: outbox-relay-next
title: Outbox relay route (Next.js)
description: app/api/outbox/route.ts: a cron route that relays each registered consumer's events.
docs: Needs the outbox block: `npx better-supabase add outbox`. Schedule it with `{ "crons": [{ "path": "/api/outbox", "schedule": "* * * * *" }] }` in `vercel.json`, and set a random `CRON_SECRET` in production. With a `src/` folder, move the file to `src/app/api/outbox/route.ts`. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/outbox.
